title: ID0422294-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P7 170000667]-Charger in failsafe mode
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Charger in failsafe mode.
Solution:

additional_info.subject: Status update
additional_info.body:
Charger is no longer in FailSafe mode. Router 2 was blocking IP Linux Application Board, after force to allow communication the charger boots normally.
Now I'm just waiting to someone release the emergency button to be sure everything is ok.
RC is informed about the status.

additional_info.subject: 0422294 - ID0422294-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P7 170000667]-Charger in failsafe mode CRM:00472000289
additional_info.body:
Hello Markus,
After removing the blocked IP of Linux Application Board from router 2 the charger was able to boot in normal condition.
After booting the emergency button was activated but today someone already deactivated and the charger was fully operational.
I will proceed to close this ticket.
